features.label: Simplified sizing for your cti brace
features.text: Measure your thigh circumference 15 cm above the middle of your kneecap to find your ideal fit in either Small/Medium or Large/X-Large, ensuring your rigid brace is fully covered.

features.label: Ultimate impact-absorbing padding
features.text: Keep yourself and your opponents safe on the field. The integrated padding cushions your rigid carbon fiber frame, making your brace compliant for contact sports like football, rugby, and lacrosse.

features.label: Comprehensive brace protection
features.text: Guard your medical equipment against the elements. This durable padded cover forms a robust shield over your hinges and straps, effectively blocking out dirt, mud, and debris whether you are riding motocross or tackling daily chores.

features.label: Universal cti compatibility
features.text: Designed specifically for the Ossur CTi ecosystem, this highly durable cover easily slides directly over both custom and off-the-shelf (OTS) rigid frames for quick, hassle-free prep on the sidelines.

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our US-based brace specialists for personalized support.

measurement: Sizing is based on thigh circumference measured 15 cm above mid patella. Perfect Fit Promise
